hops.rationale: Scope is KO, filing year 2025 (accession 000002134425000011), Item 7 only. The passages together cover the requested FX impact disclosures. They state the total FX impact on net operating revenues (a 5% decrease in 2024 and 4% in 2023, including hedging) and on operating income (11% and 8%). They attribute the operating income decline to a stronger U.S. dollar against named currencies, partly offset by the euro and British pound. Segment-level impacts are given, such as Europe, Middle East & Africa (15%) and Latin America (17%). They also cover net foreign currency exchange losses of $180M (2024) and $312M (2023), recorded in other income (loss) net, the hedging program, and management's outlook for unfavorable FX on full-year 2025 net operating revenues. Evidence is limited to current scope; the Amazon filing is out of scope. No further retrieval is needed.
